crossRefs.note: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil…
the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;
Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle, put up the veil for the screen, and shielded off the ark of the Testimony, just as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: and he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
